module: Module 2: MAM Allocation Methods & Sizing Engine
title: Predefined Percentage Allocation: Validation of Sum == 100%
precondition: Manager attempts to save percentage settings summing to 95% or 105%.
expected: System blocks save with error: 'Total allocation percentage must equal exactly 100.0% (Current: 95.0%)'.
coverage_note: The specified allocation policy/currency/conserved-block fixture is not represented by the tested multiplier/balance/equity copy model.
